title: --check: a hunk after a failing hunk of the same block is still checked
notes: §12 item 33 (AMBIGUITIES R16): §8.6 says check mode continues 'with the remaining blocks ... so that every block and hunk receives a status (checked or failed)'; the hunks after a failing hunk of the same block are matched as if the failed hunk had been skipped (cursor unchanged).
